# BTS ↔ Cursor Architecture Mapping (v1)

## 1:1 mapping
- Cursor: file hash → MetaBlooms: artifact hash / node_hash
- Cursor: Merkle tree → MetaBlooms: MBMI merkle_root.json
- Cursor: incremental sync → MetaBlooms: reuse_registry.json + coverage proofs
- Cursor: semantic retrieval → MetaBlooms: MBMI query + BTS index_lookup record

## Divergence (MetaBlooms stronger)
- BTS records instinctive vs governed tool choice (Cursor does not)
- BTS records rejected tools (Cursor does not)
- Gates enforce stage/tool compliance (Cursor does not)

## Divergence (Cursor stronger)
- Mature incremental repo indexing + workspace similarity reuse

## MetaBlooms target state
Use Cursor-style indexing primitives, wrapped in BTS + gates, generalized beyond code to all artifacts.
